  "markdown": "# LocalCheck

> LocalCheck gives local communities one shared platform for their courts, activity, and competition. See who is there now, who plans to play later, organize the run, and build trusted friend, court, and regional rankings from reviewed games.

LocalCheck covers 1 source-backed courts across 1 US cities at launch: 1 basketball and 0 pickleball. Contact: localchecksports@gmail.com.

## What makes LocalCheck different

- **Intent, not history.** The weekly heatmap is built from locals marking the hours they plan to show up, so it answers "will there be a run at 6pm Tuesday" rather than "was this court busy last month".
- **Geofenced check-in.** Check-in only works when you are physically at the court, so a live count of three means three real people. Counts start at zero and are never fabricated.
- **Reviewed scores and useful rankings.** Logged games go to the opponent for approval or dispute before they count toward Elo and friend, court, or regional leaderboards. Unresolved games are voided rather than recorded wrong.
- **Verified court submissions.** New courts require a live location lock plus a live camera capture that is AI-analyzed; photo-library uploads are rejected.
- **Free core app, optional LocalPlus.** Court discovery and core features are free. LocalPlus is an optional subscription; see the Starter and Pioneer launch offers. No cross-app tracking.

## Start here

- [The LocalCheck app](https://localchecksports.com/app): Screen-by-screen overview of the heatmap, check-in, scheduled games, Elo competition, profiles, and court verification.
- [How LocalCheck works](https://localchecksports.com/how-it-works): Full explanation of the weekly heatmap, geofenced check-in, scheduled runs, Elo ratings and score disputes, home courts, and AI-verified court submissions. Includes answers to the most common questions.
- [Court explorer](https://localchecksports.com/courts): Browse and filter all 1 launch courts by sport and city, as a map or a list.
- [Homepage](https://localchecksports.com/): Product overview, live launch stats, and app preview.
- [Pioneers](https://localchecksports.com/pioneers): Starter and Pioneer LocalPlus launch offers for the first 100 players and people who build a new court community.

## Key questions LocalCheck answers

- Where can I play pickup basketball or pickleball near me right now?
- Is anyone actually at a specific court at this moment?
- What time of week is a given court busiest?
- Who are the regulars at my local court, and how do I rank with friends, at that court, and across the region?
- How do I find a scheduled pickup game to join?
- How do I get a court added to the map?

## Houston

1 court — 1 basketball, 0 pickleball.

- [Kasmiersky Park](https://localchecksports.com/courts/kasmiersky-park-c09ec673): Basketball · Conroe, TX · public and free. Live check-ins, weekly plan heatmap, and access details.

## Policies and support

- [Privacy Policy](https://localchecksports.com/privacy): What LocalCheck collects, how it is used and shared, retention, and account deletion. No third-party advertising or cross-app tracking.
- [Terms of Service](https://localchecksports.com/terms): Account rules, acceptable use, community standards and enforcement, court submission rules, and safety disclaimers.
- [Support](https://localchecksports.com/support): How to reach us with questions, bugs, or reports.

## Platform

- Platform: iOS. Core app: free. LocalPlus: optional subscription.
- Sports at launch: basketball and pickleball.
- Safety: every player profile has Report Player and Block Player controls; reports go to localchecksports@gmail.com.
